label: X
enables: Posting approved X drafts for you, if you turn it on. Later: reading the accounts you follow while signed in.
connect: Help me connect my brand's X account to Fishbowl Studio. Don't ask for my password, don't type it for me and don't store anything: walk me through signing in to x.com myself, in my own browser (the one Claude in Chrome uses), one step at a time, then check with me which account is open. The studio only notes that it's connected.
post_warning: Posting to X by automation breaks X's rules, and X can restrict or suspend the account.
